Madam,

I have gone along the benches twice before writing. I make it 2 members wavering, and I would not put it higher or lower until I have spoken to each.

Your servant,
Bram Tull

Madam,

My count of the Council as it stands: 8 votes for the levy. I have counted twice. I will write again when it moves.

B. Tull

Madam,

The count holds at 8 votes for the levy. Nobody has come over and nobody has gone off; I give it you as I find it.

B. Tull

Madam,

Still 8 votes for the levy by my reckoning. I would sooner send you a dull count than a hopeful one.

B. Tull
